description.value: Lucy's Cafe & Bakery is an Ethiopian cafe and bakery operating in a small unit on Sixth Avenue, formerly known as 6th Ave Bread & Deli. The shift to Ethiopian cuisine makes it a distinctive cultural dining stop in what appears to be a New Westminster neighbourhood. Indoor seating is available in a no-smoking setting, offering touring cyclists a sit-down rest option.
